WorkItemRights.Read : WorkItemRights.ReadAndWrite); The domain model branches on tracker identity and reads two connection fields. The Jira sign-in rights are also decided in JiraOAuthProvider.ScopesFor, and WorkTrackingSystemConnectionDto.cs:57 enumerates the OAuth keys. Non-blocking: all runs R3 to R5 pass.
findings.remediation: Move the rights default for a sign-in stored before rights were recorded onto the tracker's provider, one owner per tracker, and pass the resolved default into OAuthCredential. Then OAuthCredential holds no tracker branch and takes no connection. Keep the four ConsentedRightsOn unit cases and the acceptance scenarios green.
